metadata.description: AST-expansion conformance fixture for grids/cartesian_uniform_1d/rules/ppm_D_periodic: a minimal consuming model binding N=8 at the import edge. The plain match D(u,x) fires at priority 10 and lowers, through the section-9.6.3 fixpoint (with the ppm_face_value / ppm_limit_right / ppm_flux / ppm_D_interior body-reference templates inlined at load per esm-spec 9.7.3), to the rule's makearray -- interior [4,6] holding the conservative PPM flux-difference aggregate (F_{i+1/2}-F_{i-1/2})/dx with F the CW84-limited semi-discrete upwind edge flux, and the five explicit periodic-wrap faces i=1,2,3,7,8 -- with all metaparameters folded, zero apply_expression_template nodes, zero unlowered rewrite-target ops (the spatial D is gone), and the free name dx surviving in the expanded body (the grid's consumer-supplied geometry contract). The model fulfills that contract with x0 = 0 and dx = 1/8; the dx expression is spelled with the literal 8 because the edge binding closes N before it reaches this document's scope (grids/cartesian_uniform_1d/grid.esm). The golden pins the byte-identical post-lowering AST across bindings.
metadata.name: ppm_D_periodic_ast_fixture

ppm_flux.description: F_{i+1/2}=CW84 limited right edge of the upwind cell u0

ppm_slope.description: CW84 eq.(1.7) uniform-mesh average slope (ap - am)/2

ppm_slope_mono.description: CW84 eq.(1.8) monotonized slope: 0 at an extremum, else the raw slope clamped to +-2 min(|a0-am|,|ap-a0|)

x_coord.description: Cell-center coordinates x_i = x0 + (i - 1/2) dx, shaped over the x index set. x0 and dx are free names supplied by the consuming model (see metadata.description for the contract).

c.description: Constant transport speed (non-negative; the PPM upwind flux assumes flow in +x).

dx.description: Grid spacing 1/N = 1/8, spelled with the literal 8: the import edge binds N, closing it before this document's scope (grids/cartesian_uniform_1d/grid.esm contract).

u.description: Advected tracer field over the x index set.

x0.description: Left domain edge a = 0: the grid's x0 free name (consumer-supplied geometry contract).
